name: ConnectX
tagline: The contact center with an AI agent inside.
description: IP telephony, AI voice agents, omnichannel routing and agent workspaces with supervisor tools, recording, reporting and workforce management.
overview: ConnectX brings IP telephony, self-service, routing and agent operations into one contact-center platform. An AI voice agent handles supported questions using approved content and connected systems, with identity checks and a contextual handoff when a person is needed. Agents work across voice, chat, email, WhatsApp and social channels, while supervisors review recordings, quality scores, queues and workforce performance. Customer-managed deployment supports existing IP handsets and integration with banking, CRM and operational systems.
overviewParagraphs: ConnectX brings IP telephony, self-service, routing and agent operations into one contact-center platform. An AI voice agent handles supported questions using approved content and connected systems, with identity checks and a contextual handoff when a person is needed. Agents work across voice, chat, email, WhatsApp and social channels, while supervisors review recordings, quality scores, queues and workforce performance. Customer-managed deployment supports existing IP handsets and integration with banking, CRM and operational systems.

The AI agent sits in the core of the platform rather than in front of it. It answers only from approved content and connected systems, applies an identity policy your risk team reads and edits as a table, and hands the conversation to a skilled agent with full context when a request is sensitive or unsupported. Language coverage, supported operations, deployment topology and retention are confirmed during evaluation.

problems.pain: A contact center assembled from separate products
problems.outcome: Telephony, IVR, routing, agent desktop, supervisor tooling, recording, omnichannel, reporting and workforce management in one platform, one admin console and one database.

problems.pain: Callers queue for questions a system could answer
problems.outcome: The AI agent answers supported questions from approved sources and connected systems, and only the rest reach a person.

problems.pain: Customers repeat themselves on every channel
problems.outcome: One universal queue and one customer history across voice, chat, email, WhatsApp and social.

problems.pain: Every prompt or routing change waits on a developer
problems.outcome: Prompts, menu words, wrap-up codes and routing rules are maintained by your own business team in the console.

faqs.a: Yes. Telephony, IVR, routing, agent desktop, supervisor tooling, recording, omnichannel, reporting, workforce management and outbound dialing ship as one platform, with one admin console and one database. A separate telephony, recording or workforce product is not required.

faqs.q: What does the AI agent actually do?
faqs.a: It answers supported voice and chat questions using approved content and connected systems, applies your identity policy before disclosing anything, and hands the conversation to an agent with full context when a request is sensitive or unsupported.

The agent is built for Bangla and English, and for the two mixed in the same conversation, locked to the language the customer chose rather than guessed. Confirm the coverage your customers need during evaluation.

faqs.q: Can customers complete transactions without an agent?
faqs.a: Supported self-service operations are connected to your authorized systems and governed by your identity policy. Which operations are enabled, and at which identity tier, is defined by your own risk team during evaluation.

faqs.q: How do we change a prompt or a routing rule?
faqs.a: In the admin console. Prompts, menu words, wrap-up codes, the VIP list and routing rules are maintained by your business team, with no code change and no release.

faqs.q: Can agents keep the handsets we already have?
faqs.a: Agents can use the WebRTC softphone in the browser, or SIP handsets connected to the platform. Specific handset and headset models are confirmed during evaluation.

faqs.q: Where does ConnectX run, and what should we review?
faqs.a: ConnectX is a customer-managed deployment on infrastructure you control. Review telephony and trunk requirements, identity policies, integration specifications, retention, training and support terms during evaluation. No hosting region or certification is implied.

faqs.q: What is in the first release, and what comes later?
faqs.a: The AI agent, IVR self-service, ACD and skill routing, the agent desktop, the supervisor console, the knowledge base, the wallboard and the value board are delivered first, with SNMP traps and Syslog for your monitoring team. Call recording and quality scoring, workforce management and the outbound dialer, the drag-and-drop flow designer, call transfer and conference, and the Power BI and CRM connections are scoped in the implementation plan and delivered with the Enterprise tier. The split is agreed in writing during evaluation.

evaluation: Bring your channel requirements, concurrent-agent count, approved telephony provider, identity policies and integration specifications. Confirm language coverage, deployment topology, retention, training and support terms during evaluation. No hosting region or certification is implied.
